verdict.statement: Greenness (NDVI) fell by 0.10 relative to the control trajectory in the 12 months after 11 Jan 2023 (90% interval −0.13 to −0.05). The same test was run on 60 untouched control cells. In 43 of them the no-event prediction missed by as much after the event date, relative to how closely it matched before, as it did here (placebo p = 0.72). Counted by gap size instead, 0 of the 60 moved at least as far as this area did in the same direction (p = 0.02). But: the control trajectory does not track the area well enough before the event (pre-event error 0.07 vs typical 0.02).
